scope: Current production PinPin, Mama, Mr. Pompom profiles 0 and 180, plus old PinPin 0. Four source frames each. No runtime or image-generation changes.

methodology.type: Manual landmark audit with source-pixel crosshair review; not frame-count or whole-image hash inference.
methodology.landmark: Representative exposed distal toe-pad point on each visible paw, not an identified anatomical digit. Annotated crosshairs were visually reviewed.
methodology.sourceCoordinates: Zero-origin PNG sheet pixels, x right, y down. Source originals are 1254x1254.
methodology.normalization: bodyAnchorSource = cropRect.xy + frame.anchor. anchorRelativeXY = sourceXY - bodyAnchorSource; normalizedXY = anchorRelativeXY / direction.referenceWidth. For 180, forwardNormalizedX negates normalized x.
methodology.anchorCaveat: The runtime anchor is authored near the feet, not an independently tracked hip/shoulder. Low anchor-relative y range partly reflects baseline alignment. Horizontal pose holding is more independent; no assertion of absolute anatomical immobility follows.
methodology.confidence: Near toe location +/-3 source pixels per axis; partial far toe +/-5. These are visual picking bounds, not statistical confidence intervals. A near-toe range <=6 px is unresolved at this precision, not proof of exact zero.
methodology.limbs: nearFore/nearHind name the visible near-side components. farFore is a probable attribution for underbelly/behind-forepaw patches; the hidden proximal connection prevents guaranteed identity continuity. Far hind toes are unobserved. Null is not a stationary coordinate.
methodology.missingData: No interpolation, zero filling, or reuse of visible coordinates for hidden frames. Partial-sample ranges are not full-cycle ranges.
methodology.cycleCriterion: Look for identifiable per-leg stance, lift, swing and return in frame order 0-1-2-3-0. Mere pixel differences, vertical bob or appearing/disappearing behind another limb do not certify a complete four-leg cycle.

pixelCheck.meaning: All marked points land on colored paw pixels. This checks placement, not anatomical identity.

independentBodyCrosscheck.scope: Bounded independent-landmark crosscheck only: PinPin 180 nearHind and Mama 0 nearFore, four frames each. Original toe picks unchanged.
independentBodyCrosscheck.landmark: Manually picked center of visible near-ear inner concha (dark opening), source PNG pixels. Ear is independent of foot-based rendering anchor. Full-body 2x and ear-detail 4x grids reviewed, then ear/toe crosshair overlays reviewed.

uncertainty.interpretation: Conservative additive picking bounds, not statistical confidence intervals. Values below these bounds cannot establish exact stillness or resolved small movement.

independentBodyCrosscheck.limitation: Ear is an independent visible head landmark, not a rigid skeletal hip/shoulder. Similar ear shape supports correspondence but cannot exclude subtle head rotation or body deformation. No hidden-leg inference or whole-cycle certification.

profiles.assessment: Independent ear-relative excursion is 6 x 7 px, versus 3.5 x 2 relative to foot anchor. The anchor suppressed visible vertical bob: withdraw any implication of only 2 px body-relative movement. Limited-motion rear pose remains supported; exact freezing and resolution of this small movement are not established.

Independent ear-relative excursion is 10 x 6 px, versus 11.5 x 5 relative to foot anchor. Small forward-pose wobble persists without foot-baseline normalization; no large stance/swing sweep observed. Picking bounds include zero, so no pixel-exact or statistically resolved small-motion claim.

independentBodyCrosscheck.conclusion: Both bounded checks support small body-relative visible-paw excursion rather than a large walking sweep. PinPin vertical excursion is larger than foot-anchor measurement. Do not generalize these two independent checks to other legs/profiles, and do not claim pixel-identical freezing.

confirmed: The 180-degree near hind paw is practically held: PinPin 3.5x2 px; Mama and Mr. Pompom 6.5x1 px range relative to the authored anchor.
PinPin/Pompom 0-degree near forepaw horizontal motion is unresolved (4/2.5 px), despite vertical motion of 28/11 px. They bob; they are not wholly static.
Mama 0-degree near forepaw only wobbles 11.5x5 px while staying extended forward.
The 0-degree near hind paws and 180-degree near forepaws move appreciably: a blanket 'all legs frozen' claim is false.
Old PinPin 0 has the same weak fore-aft forepaw pattern (9x26 px) and near-hind shift (35x4 px); new PinPin inherits rather than fixes it.
unverifiable: Pixel-exact immobility of any anatomical leg.
Motion of all far hind legs and every hidden/overlapped far forepaw sample.
Continuous anatomical identity of the underbelly paw across all frames.
A correct full four-leg forward gait cycle for any audited profile.
conclusions.disposition: Reject frame-index coverage as gait acceptance evidence. Visible pose holding is confirmed; a complete forward leg cycle is not demonstrated. This audit does not claim every leg is literally frozen.
firstRepairTargets: 180-degree visible near hind pose on all three characters.
0-degree visible near forepaw stance/swing range, especially Mama and Mr. Pompom.
Old PinPin 0 is not a gold-standard physical gait template.
